name: ubuntu-24.04-gnome
title: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, GNOME (Wayland)
hints: Desktop: Ubuntu 24.04 with GNOME (Wayland session), a top bar and a dock on the left.
Apps: the text editor is Text Editor (gnome-text-editor), the file manager is Files (Nautilus), the terminal is Terminal (GNOME Terminal), the web browser is Firefox.
To start an app: press Super (the Windows key), type the app name, press Enter. ctrl+alt+t opens a terminal.
Windows: alt+Tab switches windows, super+Up maximizes, alt+F4 closes the focused window.
